cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Provides an interactive offline STEM virtual lab and tutor to help students visualize and learn physical and mathematical sciences.

test_prompts.prompt: Explain the magnetic field lines generated by a solenoid step-by-step. Detail the effect of number of turns, current strength, and relative permeability of a soft iron core.
Derive the mathematical formula for a simple pendulum's swing period under gravity. Compare the small-angle approximation with actual behavior at larger angles.
